explication: BabelDOC is a PDF scientific-paper translation library with CLI and Python entry points, producing translated and bilingual PDFs. The principal flow configures a translator and document-layout model, parses PDF content into an intermediate document representation, detects layout and paragraphs, translates text, then typesets and writes output. The README also documents page splitting, table translation, OCR-related handling, glossaries, and watermark options.
